build_adsorbate_slab_config: build a python module to initialize AdsorbateSlabConfig with a slab and adsorbate for random site sampling
create_binding_sites: create a function to get binding sites on a slab surface using Delaunay triangulation or heuristic mode
place_adsorbate_on_site: place an adsorbate molecule at a given binding site on a catalyst slab with no atomic overlap
check_atomic_overlap: check if there is atomic overlap between surface atoms and adsorbate atoms using covalent radii
sample_triangle_sites: sample random sites uniformly on a 3D triangle using the get_random_sites_on_triangle function
